headline: Will I be alone for the rest of my life?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, but your hand found the one with every tool still available.
Every tool remains on the table, ready to be used.
You asked whether you will be alone for the rest of your life. The complete table is the part that stops me.
You are alone now, and the present has grown large enough to predict the whole future in your question.
What keeps connection away does so without emptying the table. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the card with life around the pause.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the suspended figure.
You asked whether the pause lasts for life. This card brings me to the leaves still growing.
Still, there is no relationship, and the pause feels permanent from inside it.
Something reaches the question just where the pause would open. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what has hold of this…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs were alike, yet your hand went to the beginning of the deck.
The small bundle on his stick is all he has packed.
You asked whether solitude fills the whole road. The Fool brings me to its beginning.
But the road is empty of company, and you are asking whether it stays that way.
There's something between the beginning and company. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
